import requests

api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"   # replace with your actual key
ip_address = "56.78.90.1"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}/certificates"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    # The certificates are in data['data']['attributes']['certificates']
    print(data)
else:
    print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
